description: This PHP source file handles the display of the organization sharing permissions editing interface in the vtiger CRM system. It gathers default sharing permissions, generates corresponding HTML select elements, and assigns data to a Smarty template for rendering.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Template engine instance used for rendering the UI.

methods.name: getDefaultSharingEditAction
methods.description: Retrieves default sharing permissions for modules.

methods.name: getTabname
methods.description: Returns the name of a module or tab given its ID.

methods.name: getModuleSharingActionArray
methods.description: Provides available sharing actions for a specific module.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Fetches language-specific strings for a module.
